faqs.question: What sizes of Plasson bell drinkers are available in this listing?
faqs.answer: This listing covers the full Plasson bell drinker lineup. Small chick drinker (11cm * 18cm, 200pcs/carton). Medium drinker (26cm * 27cm, 298g, 80pcs/carton). Large drinker (36cm * 33cm, 524g, 30pcs/carton). We also offer US standard large type and jumbo tall type. Please contact us to confirm which size fits your farm best.

faqs.question: Does this bell drinker require electricity to operate?
faqs.answer: No. The Plasson bell drinker uses a gravity fed inverted bucket design. As poultry drinks from the trough, water automatically refills from the bucket above. No electricity, pump, or motor needed. It works reliably in any climate and farm condition. Just hang it, fill it, and it operates 24/7 automatically.

faqs.question: Which poultry types can use this drinker?
faqs.answer: Suitable for a wide range of poultry including chickens (broilers and layers), ducks, geese, turkeys, quail, and breeder birds. The small size works for day old chicks and young poultry. Medium and large sizes suit adult broilers, layers, and ducks. The jumbo tall type works best for geese and turkeys. Perfect for both floor rearing and cage systems.

faqs.question: How to install the hanging bell drinker?
faqs.answer: Very simple. The drinker comes with a top hook. Just hang it on a rafter, suspension cable, or water pipe in your poultry house. Adjust the height so the water trough rim is at the bird's shoulder level - this prevents bedding from getting into the water. No tools required for installation. The bucket and base detach for easy cleaning between flocks.

faqs.question: Is the plastic material safe and durable?
faqs.answer: Yes. Made from virgin polypropylene (PP) plastic with UV stabilizers and anti aging additives. Non toxic and food grade, completely safe for poultry drinking water. Impact resistant, withstands pecking and scratching. Temperature range from minus 10°C to plus 60°C. Easy to clean with pressure washer. Long service life for commercial farm use.

faqs.question: What accessories are available for this drinker?
faqs.answer: We supply matching accessories to complete your watering system. Water valve for flow control. Blue connector complete set. Black 9.5mm water hose. All accessories are compatible with the Plasson bell drinker series. Buy everything from one supplier for consistent quality. Volume discounts available.

faqs.question: How does this automatic chicken drinking bowl work?
faqs.answer: It uses a gravity spring valve mechanism. When birds drink and the bowl becomes lighter, the spring lifts the bowl, closing the valve to stop water flow. When birds finish drinking, the bowl rises back into position. No electricity needed.

faqs.question: Can this be installed on a regular plastic water bucket?
faqs.answer: Yes. The white control base has a threaded inlet with a wing nut adapter that mounts onto the side wall of standard plastic water buckets. Just drill a hole and tighten the nut to seal.

faqs.question: What materials is it made of?
faqs.answer: The base and cup are made of high-impact engineering grade plastic (UV resistant). The valve contains a corrosion-resistant metal spring. The smooth surface prevents algae build-up and is easy to clean.

faqs.question: What colors are available?
faqs.answer: Red and blue drinking cups are shown in the listing. Both use the same white control base. The bright red/blue color helps poultry easily locate the water source.

faqs.question: Is it suitable for my existing poultry water line system?
faqs.answer: Yes. The threaded inlet adapter is compatible with standard PVC water pipes and most farm water line systems. You can install multiple cups along a single pipe run for large flocks.

faqs.question: How do I clean and maintain it?
faqs.answer: Simply disassemble the cup from the base by removing the side pin. Rinse both parts with water. The smooth plastic surface is easy to wipe clean. Check the valve spring seasonally for debris.
